<title level="1" right="Focus 4" pfs="Standard">
[Pulse of Civilization](/Spells.aspx?ID=1785)
<actions string="Two Actions" />
</title>

<traits>
<trait label="Uncommon" url="/Traits.aspx?ID=159" />
<trait label="Cleric" url="/Traits.aspx?ID=554" />
<trait label="Concentrate" url="/Traits.aspx?ID=32" />
<trait label="Focus" url="/Traits.aspx?ID=511" />
<trait label="Manipulate" url="/Traits.aspx?ID=104" />
<trait label="Scrying" url="/Traits.aspx?ID=141" />
</traits>

<column gap="tiny">

**Source** [Player Core](/Sources.aspx?ID=216) pg. 372

**Domain**
[Cities](/Domains.aspx?ID=66)

<row gap="medium">

 

</row>

<row gap="medium">
**Range** 25 miles

</row>

<row gap="medium">

**Duration** 8 hours
</row>

</column>

---

You tap into the zeitgeist of any settlements in range. You learn the names of the settlements. On all [Lore](/Skills.aspx?ID=8) checks to [Recall Knowledge](/Actions.aspx?ID=26) about those settlements or to [Gather Information](/Actions.aspx?ID=49) in or about those settlements, you gain a +2 status bonus and use your level as your proficiency bonus even if you're untrained. When you Cast the Spell, you can immediately Recall Knowledge about one of the settlements using its Lore skill (such as Absalom Lore), which benefits from the bonus. If you cast _pulse of civilization_ again, any previous casting ends.

---
**Heightened (5th)** The range is 100 miles.

**Heightened (7th)** The range is 500 miles and the bonus is +3.
name: Pulse of Civilization
